trust_decision.summary: An ID is only allowed to be generated once the loop can make progress: with a zero byte step the exit test `id.length >= size` can never be reached, so the non-positive/NaN-size decision must be taken inside the closure returned by customRandom, before `while (true)`; at the pinned commit that check is absent there.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'custom generators' and size zero; customRandom's returned closure is the only generation loop, and customAlphabet (index.js:68-70) is a two-line call into it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The no-argument call must keep returning a full default-size ID: customAlphabet('a', 5)() === 'aaaaa', and customAlphabet('abc')() must still give 21 characters. A guard that tests the raw argument without the `= defaultSize` default (exactly what the async copies lacked before the fix, fix.diff:34-38), or a blanket throw/empty return on 'not > 0', turns every defaulted call into '' or into another hang.

size argument negative (today returns a length-1 ID or a RangeError, must become '')
defaultSize 0 at factory time (the reported infinite-loop case)
